name: audit-mcp-query-performance
title: Prune MCP tool scans and trace-store hot paths
description: Make the amc serve MCP query tools and command-trace store flat as run data and trace history grow (audit A-039/A-040/A-041/A-042): lexicographic window pre-filter before strptime, COUNT(DISTINCT) plus memoized unsupported summary, a long-lived SQLite connection and JSONL handle, and per-component hoists in resource_snapshot. Output-identical.
